$comment: ChittySchema database-config.json — Schema Owner Manifest. Self-validates against the meta-schema referenced above. `databases[]` is the backward-compatible simple shape used by existing routes. `tableOwners[]` is the rich manifest served by GET /api/owners. Every table that is authored in an owning repo must appear in tableOwners. CI rejects PRs that violate the meta-schema (npm run validate:manifest).

databases.name: chittyos-core
databases.description: Primary operational database for ChittyOS ecosystem

databases.name: chittyledger
databases.description: Legal evidence and transaction ledger for court-admissible records

databases.name: chittycanon
databases.description: ChittyFoundation ontology governance and standards registry

databases.name: chittyevidence-db
databases.description: Evidence pipeline database: intake, classification, fact extraction, legal analysis

databases.name: chittycommand
databases.description: Command-and-control operational database for property, legal, and financial workflows

databases.name: chittyentity-tasks
databases.description: Agent task queue and interaction log for distributed ChittyAgent workers

databases.name: chittyconnect
databases.description: Integration hub: credentials, context, documents, connections, and prompts

databases.name: chittydispute
databases.description: Dispute management: property, insurance, legal, and financial issues

databases.name: chittydna
databases.description: Evidentiary + coherence double-helix: publishable entries, sections, fragments, attributions, and propagation tracking

databases.name: chittygov
databases.description: Entity governance, compliance calendar, authority resolutions, and regulatory filings for ChittyFoundation portfolio companies

databases.name: chittyfinance
databases.description: Multi-tenant financial management: LLC hierarchy, property management, COA classification, allocation engine

databases.name: chittyresolution
databases.description: Unified dispute resolution: ADR (mediation/arbitration/negotiation/neutral evaluation) + Litigation (filings/motions/discovery), shared evidence + timeline, contract lifecycle, RTLO compliance

databases.name: chittyharvest
databases.description: Garden IO bridge state — gardens, threads, messages, identity links, adapter runs. Local SoR for cross-garden communication; never stores credentials, never canonical for identity authority.
